verdict.rationale: Crossmint's agent stack is buyer-side: Agent Checkouts lets an agent buy from any merchant given a product URL, and Agent Cards and Wallets let agents pay. Its merchant-facing headless and embedded checkout runs inside the merchant's own app. Nothing in the evidence lets a merchant list or sell products for in-chat purchase in ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini or Copilot, so the buyer-side capability is adjacent and earns no credit.

support.subject: As a merchant, buyers can complete purchases of my products inside chat and assistant surfaces (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Copilot and peers)
